items.html: Afterwards, in the Second Temple, she ascended on the days of Shabbat face to face, in the sixth aspect; but on weekdays she ascended face to face in the fifth aspect — that she was a Partzuf of complete ten Sefirot, and the measure of her stature was from his chest and below, face to face; and his five [Sefirot] illuminated in her from afar, but she did not ascend opposite them exactly, as she was in the First Temple on weekdays.
